definitions.explanation: The part that is on the outside or facing outward.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{外側|そとがわ}を{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}す。
examples.english: To repaint the outside of the building.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}の{外側|そとがわ}を{拭|ふ}く。
examples.english: To wipe the outside of the window.

examples.japanese: カーブでは{外側|そとがわ}のタイヤに{負担|ふたん}がかかる。
examples.english: On a curve, the stress is on the outside tire.

notes:
{外側|そとがわ} refers to the outside surface or exterior portion of something, as opposed to its interior.

WORD FORMATION:
{外|そと} (outside) + {側|がわ} (side). The pattern X{側|がわ} is productive for indicating sides or aspects.

CONTRAST WITH {内側|うちがわ}:
- {外側|そとがわ}: outside, outer surface
- {内側|うちがわ}: inside, inner surface

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {外側|そとがわ}から{見|み}る: to look from outside
- {外側|そとがわ}に{向|む}く: to face outward
- {外側|そとがわ}を{掃除|そうじ}する: to clean the exterior
- {外側|そとがわ}に{塗|ぬ}る: to apply to the outside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外|そと}: outside (general)
- {外部|がいぶ}: exterior, external (more formal)
- {表面|ひょうめん}: surface
